faq.q: Is dividend income taxable in India?
faq.a: Yes, dividend income declared, distributed, or paid on or after April 1, 2020, is fully taxable in the hands of the shareholders as per their applicable income tax slab rates.

faq.q: What is the record date for a dividend?
faq.a: The record date is the specific date set by a company to determine which shareholders are eligible to receive the declared dividend. Only those holding shares on or before the record date will receive the dividend.

faq.q: Is TDS applicable on dividend income?
faq.a: Yes, for resident shareholders, TDS at 10% is applicable if the total dividend income from a company exceeds ₹5,000 in a financial year. For non-residents, a 20% TDS rate applies, subject to DTAA provisions.

faq.q: Can I claim expenses against dividend income?
faq.a: You can claim a deduction for interest expenditure incurred to earn dividend income, limited to 20% of the total dividend income. No other expenses like brokerage or commission are allowed as deductions.

faq.q: How do corporate results impact my investments?
